summary: Most of Attempt 4's gaps are verified closed: TASK-035 now carries structured `block` metadata, TASK-058 added `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-generate.js` and the exact `legacy-convergence.md` heading anchor, Attempt 4 Gap 2 is fully closed (`TASK-037.done_when[0]`, `TASK-055.outcome`, `TASK-044.outcome` and `boundaries[1]` are all reconciled, with zero residual `后续任务承接` matches across `.skeinn/`), `TASK-054` now leads with open `GH#15` and explicitly specifies `stat_data.` prefix stripping, `TASK-055` added `GH#15b` `ctxSubscribed`, `skeinn task next` returns executable P0 `TASK-054`, `skeinn check` reports `healthy: true, errors: 0, warnings: 3` (57 tasks: 46 done, 3 blocked, 8 open), and `prepared_digest` is fresh. However, handoff still requires one final surgical revision on 3 verified gaps: (1) Attempt 4 Gap 1 was left half-closed in `.skeinn/PROJECT.md` — lines 8-9 were missed when updating lines 113-117, so line 9 still lists blocked `TASK-035` as active frontier and omits `TASK-058` while line 8 still leads `TASK-054` with retracted `GH#14` wording instead of `GH#15`; (2) first executable P0 task `TASK-054` omits `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-data.js` (the only file that can read `settingsRepo`/`disabledExtensions` during `POST /api/utopinn/import/preview`) and `import-pipeline.js` from `reads`, leaves `GH#2` `character_state` sidecar persistence in tension with `guardrails[1]` (no `character_state` Repo exists; sidecars use `characters.js` atomic helpers, and read-side merge/namespace in `generate-context.js:399-402` is unspecified), while `TASK-055` omits `apps/server/src/services/generate-context.js` (needed for `quiet-generation.js` selective `lorebookEntries` WI filtering) and `apps/server/tests/quiet-generation.test.mjs`, and `TASK-055.acceptance[3]` checks `subscribed` without verifying `host.event` delivery to `ctx.eventSource.on('char_message_rendered', ...)`; (3) `TASK-058`'s legacy-call sweep (`acceptance[2]`) omits `characters` from its `rg` check and misses two live legacy `POST /api/characters/all` calls (`apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs:236,1248`) plus `checkNoActiveGroupJob` (`utopinn-cli.mjs:453`), while omitting `luker-generation.js` from `reads`.

gaps.gap: Missing primary implementation files and storage-seam contract in first executable P0 task `TASK-054` (and `TASK-055`): (1) `TASK-054.acceptance[3]` (`GH#3`) requires `import-preview` to report card regex status including when `disabledExtensions` disables regex (`含 disabledExtensions 禁用时明示不执行`), yet on disk `apps/server/src/services/import-pipeline.js:1-6` is explicitly a pure analysis module (`无 express、无 storage、无 fs、无 config`) with zero access to `settingsRepo` — the `POST /api/utopinn/import/preview` handler that reads `handle` and repos (`getSettingsRepo()`, `getWorldInfoRepo()`) is `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-data.js:509-539`, which is omitted from BOTH `TASK-054.reads` and `TASK-054.touches` (and `import-pipeline.js` is in `touches` without `reads`); (2) `TASK-054.acceptance[2]` (`GH#2`) requires persisting `set_char_variable` / `character` domain macro writes to `character_state` sidecar while `TASK-054.guardrails[1]` mandates `所有持久化写入由 apps/server 经 Repo 层完成(core-engine.md)` — on disk `apps/server/src/storage/repositories/` has NO `character_state` Repo (`storage/README.md:45-56`), and `character_state` sidecars (`<char>.state.<ns>.json`) use atomic sidecar helpers in `apps/server/src/endpoints/characters.js:2798-2850` (reused by `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-library.js:1741-1940`, per `storage-engine-semantics` C6); furthermore, `generate-context.js:399-402` currently only reads `card.data.extensions.tavern_helper.variables` (not `character_state` sidecar) and `persistMacroVariableWrites` (`generate-context.js:928-1081`) does not receive `request.user.directories`, yet `TASK-054` omits `characters.js` from `reads`, leaves the `character_state` namespace unspecified, and omits read-side merge in `acceptance[2]`; (3) `TASK-055.acceptance[1]` (`GH#9`) requires `quiet-generation.js 支持选择性 WI 注入` (`lorebookEntries` filtering), yet `apps/server/src/services/quiet-generation.js:139-150` delegates WI filtering to `buildGenerationContext` in `apps/server/src/services/generate-context.js:594-597` (where `overrides.skipWIAN` is a boolean that wipes all `entries = []`), and `verify_by` runs `apps/server/tests/quiet-generation.test.mjs`, yet `TASK-055` omits BOTH `apps/server/src/services/generate-context.js` and `apps/server/tests/quiet-generation.test.mjs` from `reads`/`touches`; additionally `TASK-055.acceptance[3]` (`GH#15b`) only asserts `ctxSubscribed` appears in `subscribed` without verifying end-to-end `host.event` delivery into a card's `ctx.eventSource.on('char_message_rendered', ...)` listener (requested by Attempt 4 Gap 3's `evidence_to_close`).
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: `TASK-054` is the exact first task returned by `skeinn task next`. A fresh Agent starting `TASK-054` cannot implement `import-preview`'s `disabledExtensions` check inside pure `import-pipeline.js` without editing undeclared `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-data.js`, and hits an immediate guardrail/seam contradiction on `GH#2` `character_state` sidecar persistence (no Repo exists, namespace and read-side merge in `generate-context.js:399-402` are unspecified). Likewise an Agent picking up `TASK-055` cannot implement selective `lorebookEntries` WI filtering in `quiet-generation.js` without editing undeclared `apps/server/src/services/generate-context.js`.
gaps.evidence_to_close: In `TASK-054`: add `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-data.js`, `apps/server/src/services/import-pipeline.js`, and `apps/server/src/endpoints/characters.js` to `reads`, and add `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-data.js` to `touches`; specify the `character_state` sidecar namespace and symmetric read-side merge (`generate-context.js:399-402` overlaying card defaults with sidecar) + write-back (`persistMacroVariableWrites`) in `acceptance[2]`, and qualify `guardrails[1]` so card-colocated `character_state` sidecars explicitly reuse `characters.js` atomic sidecar helpers per `storage-engine-semantics` C6. In `TASK-055`: add `apps/server/src/services/generate-context.js` to `reads` and `touches` and `apps/server/tests/quiet-generation.test.mjs` to `touches`, and expand `acceptance[3]` (`GH#15b`) to verify both `subscribedEvents()` reporting `ctxSubscribed` AND actual `host.event` delivery firing a card's `ctx.eventSource.on('char_message_rendered', ...)` callback.
